# Command reference

Every command of the running app, as `penumbra-cli ctl <command>` or a control-channel request sends it (see [Control](../control.md)). `{a, b?}` lists the params, `?` marks optional ones.


## general

| command | |
|---|---|
| `ping` | Check that the control channel answers |

## audio

| command | |
|---|---|
| `audio.config` | Audio settings for this run: {enabled?} |
| `audio.devices` | The audio inputs of this machine: name, default, rate, channels, format |
| `audio.status` | Audio input streams (device, rate, channels, open, error, frames, glitches, peak per channel in dBFS) |

## blob_track

| command | |
|---|---|
| `blob_track.learn` | A tex.blob_track takes a frame as the background (the empty scene): {path, delay?} (seconds before it does, default 0) |

## calib

| command | |
|---|---|
| `calib.homography` | Homography from 4 or more point pairs (normalised DLT); {pairs: [[[x,y],[u,v]],...]} |
| `calib.project` | Pixels of world points through a calibrated camera (null behind it); {camera, points: [[x,y,z],...]} |
| `calib.solve` | Calibrate a projector from world and picture points; {pairs: [[[x,y,z],[u,v]],...], size: [w,h], initial?, options?} |

## chan

| command | |
|---|---|
| `chan.read` | Cook a chan node and read its channels (values now; {samples: true} for all); {path, output?, samples?} |

## comp

| command | |
|---|---|
| `comp.collapse` | Group side-by-side nodes into a new component, ports where wires cross; {paths, name?} |
| `comp.expand` | Dissolve a component, its nodes move up beside it; {path} |
| `comp.library` | Component files in the project's components/ and the user's library |
| `comp.load` | Add a component from a file or the library (by name); {file, path?} |
| `comp.remove` | Take a component file out of the library (into its removed/ folder); {name, place?: project \| library} |
| `comp.save` | Write a component to a file (default: the library, <name>.comp.ron); {path, file?} |

## cook

| command | |
|---|---|
| `cook.meter` | Pass times of the last 8 s: last, smoothed (1 s lag), median, 1 % high, max, cook thread busy; {samples?: [seconds ago, ms] per pass} |
| `cook.play` | Run or stop the show clock; {playing?} (default true) |
| `cook.stats` | Cook pass timings since the last reset: passes, slowest pass, longest gap, late frames, stalls; {reset?} |
| `cook.status` | Show clock, last cook pass, watched nodes, thumbnail policy |
| `cook.thumbnails` | Global thumbnail switch and rate; {mode?: always \| when_free \| never, every?: cook passes between two thumbnail cooks of a node, 1 = every frame} |

## dmx

| command | |
|---|---|
| `dmx.config` | DMX settings for this run: {enabled?, blackout?}; blackout sends zeros on every output |
| `dmx.ports` | The serial ports of this machine (name, USB ids, whether it is an FT232R like the Open DMX USB) |
| `dmx.status` | DMX outputs: target, writers, device, open, error, frames, rate asked and measured, timings in ms |

## edit

| command | |
|---|---|
| `edit.begin` | Claim editing for Claude (needs 3 s without user edits); {label?} |
| `edit.end` | Give editing back to the user |
| `edit.status` | Who is editing |

## geo

| command | |
|---|---|
| `geo.info` | Cook a geo node and describe it: parts (id, name, triangles), bounds, counts; {path, output?} |

## gpu

| command | |
|---|---|
| `gpu.info` | GPU adapter, texture size limit, memory, errors raised so far, whether lost |
| `gpu.simulate_loss` | Test aid: end the GPU device as if the driver had lost it; the app then closes as after a real loss and the next start opens paused; {confirm: true} |

## history

| command | |
|---|---|
| `history.list` | Recent history entries; {limit?} |
| `history.redo` | Redo one history entry |
| `history.undo` | Undo one history entry |

## node

| command | |
|---|---|
| `node.batch` | Apply ops as one all-or-nothing batch; {ops: [{op, ...}], label?} |
| `node.bind` | Drive a param (or one component, /t.translate.0) with a channel; {param, from, channel?} |
| `node.connect` | Connect an output to an input; {from, output?, to, input?} |
| `node.copy` | Copy side-by-side nodes with everything inside them; returns the text; {paths} |
| `node.create` | Create a node; {path, kind, params?} |
| `node.cut` | Copy side-by-side nodes, then delete them (one undo step); {paths} |
| `node.delete` | Delete a node and everything inside it; {path} |
| `node.disconnect` | Clear an input; {to, input} |
| `node.info` | One node: params, connections, cook status; {path} |
| `node.kinds` | Node types with their params, inputs and outputs; with a param, its help (what it does, type, default, range, unit, what each choice does); {kind?, param?} |
| `node.list` | Nodes under a path; {path?, recursive?} |
| `node.lock` | Lock (hold outputs) or unlock a node; {path, locked?} |
| `node.paste` | Paste the nodes copied last (or `text`) into a component or the root; {into?, text?} |
| `node.rename` | Rename a node; {path, name} |
| `node.replace` | Replace a node with one of another kind under the same name, keeping the params, wires and bindings that fit (one undo step); lists what was not kept; {path, kind} |
| `node.reset` | Start stateful nodes over (feedback, cache, time machine, tracker, filter...); a component resets the stateful nodes inside; locked nodes keep their outputs; {paths} or {path} |
| `node.set` | Set params, null resets to the default; {path, params: {name: value}} |
| `node.snapshot` | Cook a tex node (or a geo node: its picture) and write its output as PNG (8-bit sRGB); {path, output?, file?} |
| `node.unbind` | Back to the param's stored value; {param} |
| `node.watch` | Cook a node every frame (or stop); {path, watch?} |

## osc

| command | |
|---|---|
| `osc.config` | OSC settings for this run: {enabled?, max_packet?, rate?, burst?, pattern_rate?, max_addresses?} |
| `osc.learn` | Bind a param to the next OSC address that arrives with a number; {param, timeout?, wait?} or {cancel: true} |
| `osc.send` | Send one OSC message; {host?, port, address, args?: [numbers, strings, booleans]} |
| `osc.status` | OSC listeners (port, bound, packets, drops, sources), senders, recent messages, params set by address, learn |

## output

| command | |
|---|---|
| `output.list` | Connected displays (ids for out.projector's display), open output windows, projectors, pacing |

## project

| command | |
|---|---|
| `project.demo` | Open the demo project, made afresh: changes, state and layout from before are gone |
| `project.example` | Open a shipped example from a fresh copy in the user's data folder (the shipped one stays as it is); changes last until it is opened again, project.save_as keeps them; {name} |
| `project.examples` | The examples shipped with penumbra, by name, and where they lie |
| `project.info` | Project directory, unsaved changes, file errors, who is editing |
| `project.new` | Make an empty project in dir (created if missing, must hold no project.ron) and open it; {dir} |
| `project.open` | Close this project (state saved, changes written) and open the one in dir; {dir} |
| `project.recent` | Recently opened projects, newest first (the demo is not listed), and the open one |
| `project.save` | Write project.ron now, also over a file that failed to merge |
| `project.save_as` | Copy the open project (its files and the latest state snapshot) into dir (new or empty) and open the copy, a project of its own; {dir} |
| `project.settings` | Project settings with their values and what they do; {set?: {name: value}}, null resets (one undo step) |

## render

| command | |
|---|---|
| `render.frame` | Move the view.camera wired into a tex.render so its geometry fills the picture, keeping the direction (orthographic: sets its size); {path} |

## res

| command | |
|---|---|
| `res.analyze` | What the projectors need of every node they show: size, needed, verdict, suggestion; waits up to 3 s for render nodes to measure (pending: those that did not) |
| `res.optimize` | Give the nodes the suggested sizes, one undoable entry; {paths?, dry_run?} (paths: only these) |
| `res.overlay` | Colour the mappers' and render nodes' pictures by resolution (green 1:1, red coarse, blue wasted); {on?} |

## script

| command | |
|---|---|
| `script.bench` | Measure a script call: GIL attach, request round trip, trivial and 200-channel calls; {runs?} |
| `script.info` | The script node's Python: where it was found (or why not), version, state, call times, timeouts |

## spacenav

| command | |
|---|---|
| `spacenav.status` | The 3D mouse: state (searching, connected, failed), raw counts, resting offset, shaped axes, buttons; opens it if not yet |

## state

| command | |
|---|---|
| `state.config` | Snapshot timing (not stored, every start has the defaults); {interval?, restore_on_start?}. Whether node state is kept at all is the project setting persist_state |
| `state.discard` | Discard what feedback loops, caches and other nodes hold, now and in the state files (locked nodes keep theirs) |
| `state.info` | Persistent state: settings, the files in the project's state directory, the last save and restore, what a snapshot would keep now |
| `state.restore` | Give the nodes their saved state back (latest, else previous, or {file}); replaces what they hold |
| `state.save` | Take a state snapshot now and wait for the file; {timeout?} in seconds |

## system

| command | |
|---|---|
| `system.check` | Show-machine settings that can ruin a show (gaming overlay, notifications) |
| `system.fix` | Apply one check's fix; replies with what it replaced; {id} |
| `system.load` | CPU over all cores and the busiest GPU engine in percent, sampled once a second while asked for (the first call waits for a sample); on NVIDIA GPUs `nvidia`: power_w, power_limit_w, temperature_c, clock_mhz, limited_by of the GPU penumbra renders on (`matched`), else the first |
| `system.process` | This process: working set, private bytes, handles, threads; GPU memory through wgpu's allocator |
| `system.restore` | Write back what system.fix replaced; {previous} as system.fix returned it |

## table

| command | |
|---|---|
| `table.read` | Cook a table node and read its rows; {path, output?, rows?} (rows: at most, default 100) |

## text

| command | |
|---|---|
| `text.fonts` | Font families and their styles, for tex.text's font and style; {family?} |

## ui

| command | |
|---|---|
| `ui.arrange` | Arrange the nodes so wires cross little and run straight: {nodes?: [path]}, else every level (one undo step per level) |
| `ui.camera` | The viewer's 3D view of a render or geometry: {mode?: picture\|free\|steer, home?, camera?: {eye, target, roll, fov, ortho?}, orbit?: [yaw, pitch], pan?: [right, up], dolly?, travel?: [right, up, forward], look?: [yaw, pitch], roll?, take?}; moves go to the free view's camera, or in steer mode to the camera node (orthographic: dolly scales its size); take puts the free view into it |
| `ui.click` | Click an element or a point; {id \| x, y, button?, double?, ctrl?, shift?, alt?} |
| `ui.drag` | Drag between elements or points; {from: {id \| x, y}, to: {id \| x, y}, button?, steps?} |
| `ui.elements` | Automation ids with rects in points; {prefix?} |
| `ui.enter` | Show the inside of a component in the editor, the top level without a path; {path?} |
| `ui.frame` | Fit all nodes into the editor |
| `ui.key` | Press a key (egui name: Delete, Tab, F, Z, Enter, ...); {key, ctrl?, shift?, alt?} |
| `ui.measure` | How tidy the level shown is, in graph units: the nodes' width and height, total and longest wire length, crossings, wire length running on top of a wire from another output (overlap, and where: overlaps) or through nodes |
| `ui.options` | The editor's options (right-click on empty space) and the viewer's channel options; {chan_bars?, viewer_background?, binding_lines?, chan_scale?: auto\|shared\|per_channel (auto: a lane per channel when one that moves would be flat on a shared scale), audio_view?: meters\|plot (what the viewer shows of a chan.audio_analysis: meters, beat and spectrum, or the channel plot), viewer_aspect?: auto\|number (the viewer's picture area, width over height; its height follows the column's width; dragging the viewer's edge sets it, auto is 16:9)} |
| `ui.place` | Move nodes in the editor; {nodes: {path: [x, y]}} |
| `ui.screenshot` | PNG of the window; {file?} (default %TEMP%/penumbra/ui.png) |
| `ui.scroll` | Mouse wheel over an element or point; {id \| x, y, dy} |
| `ui.select` | Select nodes in the editor (it shows the component they sit in); {paths} |
| `ui.state` | Selection, viewer, pan and zoom, editing mode, the status bar's message; {positions?} |
| `ui.type` | Type text into the focused field; {text} |
| `ui.view` | Pin the viewer to a node, or unpin without a path; {path?, output?: name or index} |

## video_in

| command | |
|---|---|
| `video_in.config` | Camera settings for this run: {enabled?} |
| `video_in.devices` | The cameras of this machine with their modes (size, rate, pixel format, whether penumbra reads it) |
| `video_in.status` | Camera streams (device, mode, open, error, frames, fps, dropped, delay_ms from the camera's timestamp) |

## video_out

| command | |
|---|---|
| `video_out.start` | Start recording an out.video node to a new file (its params say which and how) by turning its record param on (an edit); {path}; answers with the status once recording |
| `video_out.status` | Recordings: node, recording, finishing, done, file, codec, size, fps, frames, dropped, skipped, seconds, bytes, encoder_fps, queue, error; {path?} |
| `video_out.stop` | Stop an out.video's recording and finish the file by turning record off (an edit); {path}; answers with the status |

## view

| command | |
|---|---|
| `view.free` | A render's or a geometry's scene from any camera, as the viewer's free view draws it (without its lines); {path, output?, camera?: {eye, target, roll, fov, ortho?: height}, width?, height?, file?}; no camera starts where the viewer does |
